Ders & Trale

Ders admires Trale's strong work ethic and enjoys training with them. Ders does their best to be the mentor Trale deserves. However, Ders does worry about Trale's naivete and how they'll be able to handle themselves against the Polygonal Entity.

Ders & Cirne

Ders often gets very frustrated with Cirne who doesn't seem to take their training seriously. However, Ders still cares a lot about Cirne and worries about their recklessness leading to their demise. Deep down, Ders sees a part of themself in Cirne.
